description.value: Galileo is a SoFi-owned fintech infrastructure provider, not a bank. Its platform lets other companies build and run financial products.

product_description.value: Its API-based platform handles issuing physical and virtual payment cards, mobile push provisioning, and tailored financial products. Another listing describes transaction processing (debit card, ACH, account transfer, virtual cards) and a risk platform that uses machine learning to flag fraud.

business_model_description.value: B2B platform that partners with many issuing banks to provide banking services in North and South America.

customer_description.value: Clients include fintechs, banks, and established brands; named customers include SoFi, Uala, and Save. One source says it has helped hundreds of established companies in 16 countries across North America and Latin America.

revenue.value: Roughly $824.9M revenue (one directory); between 100M and 500M (another directory)

employees.value: 250 to 500 (one profile); about 1,600 (PitchBook and another directory); 750 (Built In)

founded_year.value: Founded in 2000 or 2001, depending on the source; PitchBook lists 2001

headquarters.value: Sandy, Utah (9800 South Monroe Street, 7th Floor, Sandy, UT 84070)
Salt Lake City, Utah, USA (one profile; Built In also lists Salt Lake City)
